thread:
maria: Heads up — candidate for Senior Infra Eng (L4) needs a comp-band exception. Hiring manager wants L5 base due to counteroffer + relocation. Proposed base $205,000 (band cap $190,000) + $25k sign-on. Start requested 2026-04-13. Can we route an exception?

ajay: @maria please drop the comp-exception form link and manager rationale. We'll need VP + finance sign-off.

maria: Form: https://hr.internal.redwood.com/comp-exceptions/req-4921 — justification: critical infra skillset, multiple competing offers, immediate impact on platform roadmap. Manager sign-off attached.

diane: Candidate said they'd accept only if we can start 4/13. If we push to 4/20 we risk losing them. Recommend approve.

ken: Quick finance check — we need the total OTE and which budget code. Also note payroll timing: starting 4/13 falls into the current payroll period; payroll will prorate salary unless we do retro. Policy snippet: `Sign-on paid first payroll after start unless onboarding >30 days; base proration handled by payroll ops.` I'll need a confirm to proceed.

offer-bot: Offer draft generated (v1) for review, status: pending-comp-approval.

ajay: Routing proposed: 1) People Ops (maria) verify docs 2) Finance (ken) approve budget 3) VP comp committee (lena) final sign-off. I can kick off the review workflow in Workday and notify the comp committee — link to ticket: https://board.redwood.com/comp/reviews/4921

maria: Uploaded supporting docs to the comp-exceptions tracker and added manager justification. Asking for a thumbs / +1 here so I can route to VP.

ken: +1 from finance on the one-time base exception + sign-on, contingent on assigning ENG-PLATFORM-2026 as the charge code and documenting the business case in the tracker.

diane: :thumbsup: please send it today.

maria: Routing to VP now — @lena please review when you have a moment. If approved today we can extend offer and keep the start date.

lena: Reviewed. Approve as a one-time exception. Record the reason and mark as non-precedent. @maria proceed with offer.

maria: Done — offer finalized and sent at 16:42. Candidate accepted verbally and requested onboarding checklist. I'll open the onboarding ticket.

ajay: Thanks all — I've assigned the charge to ENG-PLATFORM-2026 and closed the comp-exception review ticket. Will follow up with payroll for proration details.

maria: Closing thread — postmortem note: consider adding a faster payroll cutover checklist for hires that fall between payroll windows. :thinking:
__metadata_note: Each message is a single line prefixed with the sender's display name. Timestamps are only on the thread metadata per agents.md requirements.
